items.statement: The source prints the exact quadratic first-order reply and the two single-reply conversions in Section2 Equation1, and uses Borel adaptive policies, input-independent private randomness and a deterministic per-input/per-seed query cap. The author-derived bridge makes finite-fuel execution explicit: exact decoder commutation preserves every seeded terminal state, tagged some/none outcome and actual query count, both measurable joint execution laws, and ordinary expected actual count bounded by fuel. The private application carries this out in both directions for the literal Section4.1 Equation11 fixed-spectrum family, obtaining the genuine gradient reply internally. The source does not print this generic interpreter/probability theorem, and this bridge alone does not establish source-class representation, successful sampling or class-uniform query complexity.

formulae.label: Seeded joint execution and actual cost
formulae.tex: R_{\delta}(\omega)=R_t(\omega),\quad (R_{\delta})_{\#}\mu=(R_t)_{\#}\mu,\quad C_{\delta}(\omega)\le n,\quad \mathbb E_{\mu}C_{\delta}=\mathbb E_{\mu}C_t\le n.

assumptions: Let \(S,Q,A,B,X,\Omega\) be measurable spaces and \(\mu\) a probability measure on \(\Omega\). Use the standard product and disjoint-sum sigma algebras. Give \(\operatorname{Option}X\) exactly the pullback sigma algebra along \(\mathrm{none}\mapsto\mathrm{inl}()\), \(\mathrm{some}(x)\mapsto\mathrm{inr}(x)\); no StandardBorel hypothesis is imposed on \(X\).

The program data are \(\mathrm{next}:S\to X\sqcup Q\), \(\mathrm{update}:S\to Q\to B\to S\), an oracle \(o:Q\to A\), a target reply \(t:Q\to B\), a decoder \(\delta:Q\to A\to B\), and an initialization \(i:\Omega\to S\). Assume the displayed next, update, oracle, decoder and initialization maps measurable, and exact commutation \(\delta(q,o(q))=t(q)\) for every \(q\). No separate target-reply measurability premise is required.

For arbitrary fuel \(n\in\mathbb N\), \(R_\delta(\omega)\) runs the existing interpreter from \(i(\omega)\) with update \(\mathrm{update}(s,q,\delta(q,a))\) and oracle \(o\); \(R_t(\omega)\) uses update and target \(t\). Each result is \(((s_{\mathrm{final}},\operatorname{Option}X),C)\), including the actual number \(C\) of oracle interactions.

The interpreter checks next even at zero fuel. An immediate halt returns some-output and count zero. An outstanding request with zero fuel returns none and count zero. A funded request makes one oracle call and recurses with one less fuel. Early halts keep their smaller actual cost; none is fuel exhaustion and is never a successful sample.

bindings.boundary: P is author-derived Level B measurable finite-fuel simulation infrastructure, not a standalone generic theorem printed in the source. The exact reused run retains final state, some-output or none-exhaustion, and actual query count. It inspects next even at zero fuel, and does not pad counts or turn none into a successful sample. P has natural measurable-program data, exact reply-decoder commutation, a common probability seed law and arbitrary fuel. Target measurability, run measurability, count integrability and expected-cost statements are conclusions/internal steps, not added T premises. T uses the literal fixed-spectrum full orthogonal family for d≥2 and κ≥2, the Borel Euclidean carrier and exact Option pullback sigma, with μ and program policies before O. It compares foViaMV with foRun under updateFO and mvViaFO with mvRun under updateMV separately; it does not equate runs of unrelated update policies. The genuine value/gradient reply is obtained internally from the existing producer. One public P node has this associated private T with two material P applications and no extra public-node credit. No representation of every source adaptive algorithm, guaranteed successful output, class-uniform Q_G equivalence, approximate oracle, Gaussian sampling/TV accuracy, 2T hidden-block reduction, Haar/posterior law, C6 or main lower bound is claimed. ROOT actually compiled the exact new P/T working bytes at e6bff before freezing570; this is not a retrospective build of bare e6bff or a future metadata/public tree. Independent native, blind/source implementation fidelity, reader and normal PL/V remain pending. The preproof SG/TC admission is not a new-proof source verdict. Main/shared graph/site integration, purification and Goal completion remain pending.
